definition.en-US: Organizations primarily selling products or services to other businesses
Organizations primarily selling products or services directly to consumers
Organizations focused on software, hardware, digital platforms, IT services, or emerging technologies.
Senior organizational leaders responsible for strategy, decision-making, business performance, and organizational direction.
Technology professionals responsible for infrastructure, software, cybersecurity, systems, and digital operations.
Professionals responsible for financial management, budgeting, purchasing, vendor management, and organizational spending.
Teams responsible for managing business processes, logistics, service delivery, facilities, and day-to-day organizational operations.
Professionals responsible for promoting products and services, generating revenue, managing customer relationships, and driving market growth.
Teams and professionals responsible for supporting customers, resolving issues, and managing service experiences across channels.
Medical, clinical, and healthcare administration professionals responsible for patient care, healthcare operations, and medical services.
Technical professionals responsible for designing, building, maintaining, or supporting products, systems, infrastructure, and engineering operations.
Employees who directly deliver services, operate facilities, support customers, or perform operational tasks in customer-facing or field-based environments.
Individuals who purchase, use, or interact with products and services for personal use rather than on behalf of an organization.
Companies providing cloud-based software, such as CRM or inventory tools,
Companies that create products from raw materials or components to sell in bulk to other businesses (retailers, other manufacturers).
